summary: CalciMedica filed an 8-K reporting a September 30, 2026 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $25,000,000 of common stock under its August 11, 2023 sales agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The shares are covered by the Form S-3 shelf (No. 333-293972), declared effective March 11, 2026. Cooley LLP provided the legality opinion and consent. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; no price, premium, stake, advisor recommendation, or closing date is stated. Watch for incremental share suppression and cash runway signaling.
